decisions.reason: After two years the industrial AC voltage input module still fits the core automation platform, and its low incremental support cost makes it rational to retain unless evidence turns clearly negative.
The four-channel solid state relay module is a direct complement to existing control products, so as a modular adjacent option it remains worth keeping on the market.
The server room monitoring sensor kit is more application-specific and, after sufficient time to test demand, it appears less attractive than other options, so we would now reallocate the resources.
The RGB LED control module is still very new and inexpensive to keep open within the platform, so uncertainty has not resolved enough to justify abandoning it yet.
The remote access service for wallboxes supports the firm's strategic expansion in charging and energy management, making it a strong option to continue scaling.
